# How many heads a week does your indoor or hydroponic farm have to sell to break even, and how much cash does the ramp-up eat?

> Free hydroponic and indoor farm profit calculator: growing area, plant density, crop cycle, prices, lights, labour and rent become heads a week, monthly profit, break-even, the cash reserve for ramp-up, loan coverage and payback. Private, runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
